title: Simple Chat Filter
description:
A simple Chat filter to stop players from swearing!

Words are not pre-loaded into the plugin, add them yourself.
body:
Chat Filter Plugin

❤️Made By Rewrite - Made with Kotlin❤️ —————————————————————————————————————

About the Plugin

————————————————————————————————————— This Plugin adds a Simple Chat Filter to your server that helps with keeping your server safe for the community, whenever you add a word to the chat filter, not only does it revoke the permission to say the filtered words in chat, but it also stops player's from putting the text on signs AND items!

Commands

————————————————————————————————————— - /chatfilter help | Sends you a list of commands - /chatfilter add [word] | Adds the word to the ChatFilter - /chatfilter remove [word] | Removes the word from the ChatFilter - /chatfilter list | Sends a list of all the Filtered Words - /chatfilter clearchat | Clears the global chat - /chatfilter mutechat | Mutes the global chat —————————————————————————————————————

Extra

This Plugin also includes a webhook integration so whatever is sent in minecraft, will be sent in discord! ————————————————————————————————————— This plugin include webhook messages! All you need to do is simply follow this [tutorial!]

FAQ

————————————————————————————————————— 1. I don't like how the text looks, can I change it? - Yes! You can change the text in config.yml! 2. Hey, I found a bug/issue in the plugin, how can I report it? - You can contact me through [discord](https://discord.gg/qpy6E6EtSy) 3. I like what you do, is there anyway I can get something custom? - Yes! I sell custom made plugins on discord! 4.
